question: In how many phases was the last Census of 2011 conducted in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Census** is a process of collecting, analyzing, and publishing** demographic, social, and economic data** of a country's population.
 
• The** last Census of 2011 **was the **15th Census of India** and was conducted under the** Census Act of 1948.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• As of **2021**, **India's decennial censu**s has been carried out **16 times.**
 
• The first comprehensive census was taken in **1881,** though it had been conducted every ten years since** Viceroy Lord Mayo** took office in **1872.**
 
• Since **1949,** it has been managed by the** Ministry of Home Affairs**, Government of India, through the **Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India.**
 
• The** 1948 Census of India Act**, which predates the Indian Constitution, has been used to conduct all censuses since **1951.**
 
• The Union Government is not required by the **1948 Census of India Act** to carry out the Census on a specific date or to make the results available within a specified timeframe.
